formula: for each supplied component, in order: its name, a Role line as a noun phrase, then one paragraph
paragraph slot order: fill → border → radius → padding → type → contents → state → an optional closing 'only' or 'never' line
rules: fills and text as var(--immersive-…) pairs from colorVars: a fill var(--immersive-X) always with its text var(--immersive-on-X)
radius and padding as var(--borderRadius-…) and var(--space-…) from the supplied picks
type as role names from typeRoles, for example title2 or body
exactly one entry per supplied component, keeping its name

components.name: Kiln slot card
components.paragraph: var(--immersive-palette-50) fill with var(--immersive-on-palette-50) text, no border, var(--borderRadius-400) corners and var(--space-3) padding. The slot time sits in title3 above a body line for the glaze rules, then one main action. Full slots show a plain 'Full' label and never a disabled button.
